transfer_defaults_explanation: By default, tickets without a guaranteed allocation can be transferred to anyone who can buy any ticket kind for this activity. Allocated tickets can be transferred to members of the groups allowed to buy that ticket kind. Subgroups are included. You can customize this for each ticket kind.
transfer_groups_custom_activity: Some ticket kinds use custom recipient groups. These are preserved when buyer groups change. Edit individual ticket kinds, or override their recipient groups with the defaults.
transfer_default_allocated: Default: members of the groups allowed to buy this ticket kind, including subgroups.
transfer_default_ordinary: Default: anyone who can buy any ticket kind for this activity, including subgroups.
delete_addon_confirm: Delete this add-on? This cannot be undone.
addon_assignment_help: Choose which ticket kinds use this add-on. Assignments are saved with the add-on and cannot be changed after a ticket kind has purchases.
addon_bookkeeping_invalid: Enter non-negative amounts and categories whose total equals the option price.
personal_account_help: Link your app account to see your groups’ unpublished activities. Enter your Stil ID; lund-university: is added automatically if no prefix is given.
create_addons_in_activity: Open the add-on list below the activity’s ticket kinds to create or edit an add-on on its own page. Select which add-ons this ticket includes here.
unassign_addon_before_delete: Unassign this add-on from every ticket kind and save before deleting it.
crop_drag_help: Drag the crop area to move it, or drag its edges and corners to resize it. The shape stays 16:9. Keyboard: arrow keys move, +/− resize; Escape cancels.
crop_failed: Could not crop the image. Please try another image.
login_description: Sign in with your administrator email to continue.
auth_session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
unsaved_changes: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
activities_description: Activities you can administer, loaded for the visible calendar period.
activities_details: Other admins can see an activity if: they would see it if they were a normal user OR they are admins to a host group or it's subgroups OR they are admins to a group or it's subgroups which has been invited to view all of one of the host groups' activities IF the activity isn't marked 'extra hidden' (under advanced).
configure_tickets_after_creation: Save the activity first. You can configure its tickets on the next page.
activity_read_only: You can view this activity, but only direct administrators of its creator or an organizer group can edit it.
creator: Creator
creator_immutable: The creator is fixed after the activity is created.
hosts_invitation_help: Invite new organizers here. An invited group only becomes an organizer after one of its direct administrators accepts. You may only remove an organizer you directly administer.
save_before_inviting_hosts: Save the activity before inviting additional organizers.
delete_activity_confirm: Delete this activity? This cannot be undone.
delete_activity_unavailable: An activity can only be deleted while unpublished, after all ticket kinds have been deleted, and if no notification has been sent.
delete_ticket_kind_confirm: Delete this ticket kind? This cannot be undone.
delete_ticket_kind_unavailable: A ticket kind can only be deleted if it has no buyers, has never been released, and releases more than 20 minutes from now.
replace_ticket_confirm: This ticket kind can no longer be changed. Close its sales and create the edited version as v2?
purchased_ticket_edit_limits: Tickets have been purchased. Pricing, access groups and add-on structure are locked; the remaining settings and bookkeeping allocations can still be changed.
ticket_preset_help: Choose the simplest template that fits. Advanced keeps every setting available.
preset_requires_one_group: This template requires exactly one access group.
addon_statistics_help: Answers with matching add-on and option names are combined across this activity's ticket kinds.
export_all_ticket_purchasers: Export all ticket purchasers as CSV
refund_purchase_confirm: Refund this purchase in full? The payment is returned to its current owner and the purchase stops working.
host_invitations_description: Groups you administer have been invited to organize these activities.
activity_verifiers_help: Grant personal app accounts permission to scan and validate tickets for this activity. The account must already exist.
activity_capacity: Max tickets across all ticket kinds
activity_capacity_help: Normally the min and max are set on individual ticket kinds. For when you want multiple groups to "compete" for tickets, you can set their individual totals higher and this under the total. Then, no more tickets in total for the activity will be sold than is set here but the individual ticket kinds can sell as many as they can.
hide_other_admins: Make this activity extra hidden (hides it from the administrators from other groups configured in the group settings)
hide_other_admins_help: Local activity override: administrators invited through another group's settings cannot see it; direct administrators of the creator and organizers still can.
directions_placeholder: For example: Enter through the north entrance
end_after_start: The end date must be after the start date.
limit_max_tickets: Set a maximum number of tickets
capacity_too_low: Maximum tickets cannot be below {minimum} already reserved or purchased tickets.
admin_host_required: Select a group you directly administer as creator.
coordinates_together: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
invalid_coordinates: The coordinates are outside the valid latitude or longitude range.
invalid_location_url: The location link must be a valid http or https URL.
no_admin_groups: Your account does not administer any group. Ask an existing group administrator to add you.
ticket_release_too_soon: Ticket sales must start at least 10 minutes from now.
external_sales_help: Optionally add transaction fees and sales handled outside Teknologappen before generating the report.
external_report_values_invalid: External fees and sales must have a category and a valid non-negative amount.
money_input_invalid: Enter a non-negative amount with no more than two decimals.
report_download_failed: The report could not be downloaded.
groups_description: Edit groups, membership, administrators and delegated access.
limit_visibility_help: Members of this group will not automatically qualify through broader parent-group ticket rules or notifications; access must target this group directly.
propagate_member_visibility_help: Allow administrators of this group and its descendants to find members within this group tree.
child_group_help: Creates a group directly below this group and starts its path from the lowercase Swedish name.
invalid_group_path: The group path may only contain lowercase letters, numbers and underscores separated by dots.
child_path_required: A child group path must be exactly one level below its parent path.
group_path_exists: A group with this path already exists.
group_parent_missing: The selected parent group does not exist.
direct_parent_admin_required: Moving a group requires direct administrator access to its new parent.
admin_email_required: Administrators must use a user ID beginning with email:.
last_admin_required: A group must keep at least one administrator.
joiner_groups: Groups whose members may ask to join
activity_admin_groups_help: These admins can see all our (and our subgroups') activities.
delete_group_confirm: Delete this group? Existing references will remain but it will be hidden.
transfer_groups_descendants: Members of selected groups and all descendant groups may receive the ticket.
allowed_groups: Groups whose members can buy the ticket
allowed_groups_help: Only members in this groups (and it's subgroups) can buy this ticket kind. If this is left blank, no one could buy the ticket.
activity_not_published_notification: The activity is not published. Publish it before scheduling notifications.
notifications_description: Schedule notifications for groups and future activities you administer.
activity_notification_recipients_warning: This notification may be sent to everyone who can see or buy tickets for the activity. Check the recipients carefully before sending.
high_level_group_notification_warning: This is a level 1 or 2 group and may reach a very large number of people.
visible_activity_notification_warning: This will be sent to everyone who can see the activity, which may be a much broader audience than its buyers or ticket holders.
notification_recipient_all: Everyone who can see the activity
notification_recipient_buyers: Everyone who can buy a ticket
group_notification_recipients_warning: This notification is sent to every member of this group and all of its subgroups. Be especially careful when notifying a high-level group.
visibility_access: Who can see and buy this activity
activity_visibility_required: Select at least one group before publishing the activity.
visibility_access_from_ticket_kind: This access comes from a ticket kind and can only be changed in its settings.
organizers_after_creation: The selected organizers will receive invitations after the activity is created.
wizard_partial_failure: The activity was created, but one of its related ticket kinds, organizer invitations, or notifications could not be created. Open the activity to finish the setup.
shared_addon_locked: Tickets using this add-on have been purchased. Only bookkeeping can be changed.
bookkeeping_report_help: These categories group alcohol sales in the activity's sales report.
ticket_dates_order: Sales and transfer end dates must be after their respective start dates.
ticket_limits_invalid: Ticket limits must be whole, non-negative numbers; minimum must be below maximum unless both are zero.
ticket_addons_invalid: Each add-on and option needs a unique UUID, translated names, non-negative prices, and matching bookkeeping amounts and categories that add up to the option price.
invalid_group_ids: Every allowed group ID must be a valid UUID.
not_found: The requested item could not be found.
sales_start_locked: Sales start cannot change after release.
store_internal_id_duplicate: Another product in this group already uses this internal ID: {names}
delete_product_confirm: Delete this product? This cannot be undone.
stock_group_help: Where stock moved by scanning is tracked. Leave empty to disable stock sales for this activity.
api_user_help: Create an integration user that belongs to this group. The API key is shown once.
multiple_sales_groups_warning: This activity has products from more than one sales group ({groups}). Sales reporting and bookkeeping are split between them.
physical_sales_device_help: Register a device by scanning its QR code. The code is generated here and can only be used once per registration.
resale_offers_help: Purchases currently offered for resale by their owners.
external_user_help: Create an anonymous external member that belongs to this group. Share the shown user id for activity invitations.
readers_help: Pair SumUp Solo card readers with this group. The pairing code is shown on the reader.
delete_reader_confirm: Delete this reader from the group and from the SumUp account?
stock_no_group: You do not administer any group with stock management.
stock_take_out_no_activity_warning: No activity is selected. Stock taken out without an activity will not be linked to any sales. Pick an activity above if this stock is for one.
stock_take_out_no_activity_confirm: Take out stock without linking it to an activity?
sales_export_help: Download sales in the selected period as a PDF, the same report used for bookkeeping.
available_readers_help: Card readers from the activity hosts and its sales group. Pair new readers under the group.
votes_help: Create meetings and rounds for this group. Members vote from the app; results update live.
secure_voting: Secure voting (one vote per registered person)
release_allocated_confirm: All ticket stock is moved to the base ticket. Do you want to send a notification about it now?
votes_no_group: You do not administer any group.
qr_expired: The voting QR code has expired
edit_stock_transaction_help: Saving reverses the previous movement and applies the new one.
stock_all_enabled: Stock tracking is enabled for all your groups.
vote_round_draft_help: Alternatives are copied from the previous round and saved as a draft. A "Blank" alternative is added automatically.
products_description: Every product owned by the selected group, including its activity tickets.
active_group_none: You do not administer any group.
products_empty: No products in this group yet.
stock_enable_description: Turn on stock tracking for the group to follow stock levels and inventory.
news_description: Publish posts to groups you administer. Posts can have tags and a questionnaire.
news_no_tags: No tags are available for this group.
news_questionnaire_hint: Questions are shown with the post. Answers are stored as a free questionnaire purchase.
news_sent_warning: This post has been sent and can no longer be edited.
ticket_groups_subset_error: Ticket kinds other than the base ticket must be sold to a subset of the base ticket's buyers. Remove the groups that cannot buy the base ticket.
close_vote_session_confirm: Close this voting session? All rounds, votes and registered devices are deleted. This cannot be undone.
vote_admin_role_help: Adjusters can view the meeting but cannot open or close rounds, register devices, or change admins.
new_admin_is_adjuster: New admin is an Adjuster (view only)
tickets_require_other_help: If this product is sold on an activity, it requires the customer to own another ticket to the activity.
tickets_reserved_help: Reserved for the group that can buy this ticket. Only buyers of the base ticket can purchase it.
ticket_settings_stock_help: Tickets are managed automatically; each ticket is used once. The amount for sale excludes tickets promised to invited people — they always have their copy.
visibility_access_help: Groups selected here can see the activity and buy its base ticket. Changing this also changes who can buy the base ticket.
per_user_limit_help: How many tickets one person can hold for this activity across all ticket kinds. A ticket kind can still require already owning another ticket.
group_tags_help: Tags this group creates. Groups below this one can pick them when they create news, activities or products. Hidden tags can no longer be picked, but stay on existing items.
activity_take_out_stock: Take out stock for this activity
activity_take_out_stock_help: Stock taken out here is linked to the activity, and its products are added to the activity.
stock_export_help: This movement, for internal invoicing between the stock and its activity, or as the record of a purchase from a supplier.
ticket_invites_help: Invited people get a guaranteed copy of this ticket, and can buy it even if they are not in the groups allowed for it.
ticket_invites_external_help: Creates a temporary account for someone without a university login. It is added to the ticket's group.
ticket_invites_none: Choose a ticket kind to invite people to it.
ticket_base_help: The base ticket decides who can see and buy the activity. Other ticket kinds are only sold to a subset of its buyers.
ticket_capacity_untracked: Capacity is only shown when every ticket kind has automatic stock.
ticket_base_missing: This activity has no base ticket.
ticket_other_kinds_help: Only buyers of the base ticket can buy these.
stock_add_record_help: Pick what happened; each row has one kind. Taking out moves stock from the store to an activity, purchases from a supplier add to the store, sales are what was sold at the counter, and loss is stock that disappeared (spillage, a voided bottle).
stock_reconciliation_help: Per product: take-out − sold − put-back − balance + sale refunds + supplier returns − purchased. Zero means every unit is accounted for, like double-entry bookkeeping.
stock_sold_auto_help: Sales through the app are deducted from the available stock automatically; you only record what is sold by hand.
stock_graph_help: The physical stock of one product, reconstructed from its movements.
stock_graph_empty: This product has no stock movements yet.
product_unlink_activity_confirm: Unlink this product from the activity? Existing purchases are not affected.
parent_members_can_join_help: Direct members of the parent group can become members here without an approved request.
stock_balance_help: Units lost by hand, e.g. spillage or a voided bottle.
ticket_add_help: This activity has no tickets yet. Add one to start selling; the activity's current visibility and pricing are reused.
stock_infinite_help: Turn on when the item is always in stock. The available amount is what may still be sold: it drops when a ticket or item is reserved or sold, and rises when a sale is refunded or the stock is replenished.
transfers_disabled_help: Transfers are turned off for this ticket. Buyers keep their ticket and cannot pass it on.
allowed_groups_self_serve_help: Buyer groups are only used when the item is sold online with self service. Turn that on to choose who may buy it.
stock_add_purchase_help: Record what was bought from a supplier and what was returned to them. These movements never mix with store and activity handling.
stock_reconciliation_purchase_help: Supplier returns − purchases. Unlike store movements this must not be zero: the sum is what the movement changed.
stock_reconciliation_purchase_empty: Nothing bought or returned yet. Add a purchase or a return line.
stock_replenish: Add purchased amount to sellable stock
stock_replenish_help: For every product in this movement whose stock is managed automatically and is not unlimited, add what was purchased (minus supplier returns) to the amount available for sale. Only shown for saved movements.
stock_replenish_confirm: Add the purchased amount to the sellable stock of these products? This changes what can be sold online.
stock_replenish_done: Updated the sellable stock of {count} products.
visibility_access_base_ticket_help: The base ticket has been created, so who may see and buy the activity is now edited on the base ticket itself.
addon_products_help: The add-on belongs to this product. Unassign it before deleting it.
addons_save_product_first: Save the product first to add add-ons.
purchases_help: Every purchase in the selected interval, with what each product sold for and how much of it has been used.
purchases_receipt_sent: The receipt is on its way.
stock_add_stocktake_help: Add each product as you count it and enter how many are actually on the shelf.
stock_inventory_start_help: Books the whole stock down to zero in one stocktake movement and opens a movement where you count the products.
stock_inventory_start_confirm: The stock is booked down to zero in a stocktake movement; afterwards you count what is on the shelves. Continue?
stock_inventory_reset_done: Stock reset. Add the products you count.
refund_message_prompt: Message to the buyer (optional, leave empty for none):
